description: This file contains definitions for a document management module in an OpenERP/Odoo system, including classes for directories, files, content types, report actions, and configuration wizards, with methods for handling file storage, directory navigation, and system configuration.

classes.name: node_class
classes.description: Represents a node in the document directory tree, handling navigation, file retrieval, and translation.

classes.name: document_directory
classes.description: Model for managing directories in the document system, including hierarchy, duplication checks, and resource path generation.

classes.name: document_directory_node
classes.description: Inherits process.node, adds a link to a document directory.

classes.name: document_directory_content_type
classes.description: Defines types of directory content, such as file extensions.

classes.name: document_directory_content
classes.description: Model for content types within directories, including processing PDFs and reading reports.

classes.name: ir_action_report_xml
classes.description: Extends report actions with model linking capabilities.

classes.name: document_file
classes.description: Extends ir.attachment to handle file storage, indexing, and duplication checks.

classes.name: document_configuration_wizard
classes.description: Wizard for configuring system settings, including FTP server address and resource setup.
